explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at D2 it is above 0 only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition (it stays 0 for S1 and for any rare transition). That a2-to-S2-common D2 is strongest early in the episode: about 10 in trials 0-7 (8-10 after an unrewarded trial, 5-7 after a rewarded one), then roughly 1-4 around trials 15-50, and 0 from about trial 55 on.
